name: dsh-little-whale
description: DSH Web 界面里会自己长大的小鲸鱼：成长、记忆、自主生活，诗词与格律降权为二级菜单
author: qingwu-aby

scripts.test: npm run build:client && node --test tests/data.test.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs tests/domains/*.test.mjs tests/client/widget.test.mjs
scripts.test:fast: npm run build:client && node --test tests/data.test.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs tests/domains/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:eng && npm run check:types && npm run lint && node --check index.js && node --check client.js && for f in lib/kernel/*.mjs lib/composition/*.mjs lib/domain/*/index.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:eng: node scripts/check-deps.mjs && node scripts/check-size.mjs && node scripts/check-catches.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check lib/kernel lib/composition scripts/check-deps.mjs scripts/check-size.mjs scripts/gen-config-doc.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs
scripts.format: biome check --write lib/kernel lib/composition scripts/check-deps.mjs scripts/check-size.mjs scripts/gen-config-doc.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:client && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=65 --test-coverage-branches=65 --test-coverage-functions=70 tests/data.test.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs tests/domains/*.test.mjs tests/client/widget.test.mjs
